# Effects

> The Zombies zones hold 4919 particle effects. 228 are known by name; the rest only by hash.

## What you can do with them today

Nothing from the editor yet: mapkit has no node that places an effect, and a built map's list of placed ambient effects is empty. A level script can play an effect the same way the game's own scripts do, by name. See [Effects and wind](/guide/mapping/effects-wind.md).
